text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day before training, I make my way
to the
track a little early and am greeted
by a vigorous
voice.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: C'mon, keep running! Work those legs!

text_block_list.name: Sirius's Crew Member
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant! Were you watching?! I got a new personal best!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Haha, see what I mean? Focus on moving
your
legs, and keep your strides short
and crisp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli is doling out running
advice to a large group of students,
looking just as reliable as
any instructor.
However...

text_block_list.name: Timid Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear! It's Sirius and her crew of
hoodlums!

text_block_list.name: Serious Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What do we do? We can't train while
they're
here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a look around to find worried
faces on
everyone not currently on the
track. I wonder
what the issue is...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: May I have a word with you, Sirius?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The student council has received multiple
complaints that you and your
friends are unfairly
monopolizing the
track.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As such, we request that you vacate the
premises
so the other students can train
undisturbed.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Nah.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Take a look at their faces... You
understand,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
They've only broken curfew or some academy
rules, but you lot have got
them so busy writing lines or reflection
papers all the time that they've got no
time to train properly.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So it's on me to look after them and give
them a
time and place to train.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I see. But ultimately, it is still because
they've broken the rules. It would be
difficult to maintain
the academy if we
didn't enforce the rules.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying that it's fine to throw
these girls
aside over some silly little
rules?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah. Sorry, but no way I can agree with
that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's a waiting list for everything at
this academy, and breaking just one rule
is all it takes
to get pushed back on the
list.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Even if the circumstances that led to the
rule
being broken were completely out
of their hands,
it's all the same to you.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It seems to me that the academy's "rule"
is to
ignore any and all personal
circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
If we play by the book,
these girls are all
goners.
Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well, that's—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and one more thing. You said
people were
complaining to the student
council, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
So where's the Emperor herself? If this is
so
important, why isn't she gracing us
with her
presence?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know. Give her a message for me.
Tell her if she's just gonna sit on that
throne all day judging us from afar,
we've got no time to listen to her
either.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
All right, folks,
let's get back to it! Get
running!
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sirius Symboli is already back to doling
out instructions to the other students.
While she carries herself like the perfect
problem child, she also seems strangely
dependable.
